description: Unified MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configuration for AI trading agents. Replaces and consolidates the legacy RobbinHood.json and Gemini-connection.json files. All credentials are injected via environment variables at runtime; no secrets are stored in this file.

auth.headerScheme: token-prefixed Authorization header (HTTP authentication scheme), value injected from environment
token-prefixed Authorization header (HTTP authentication scheme), value injected from environment

globalSettings.description: Defaults applied to all servers unless overridden per-server above. defaultConnection (timeout/retry/heartbeat) applies to every server in mcpServers unless a server defines its own 'connection' block. Per-server risk limits are not duplicated here; agent-policies.json is the single source of truth for maxPerTradeNotionalUSD/maxDailyAggregateNotionalUSD, referenced via each server's risk.inheritFrom.
